body: Wave 2 merged (#219-#221; local at 9bfb26c, drive.sh untouched). Wave 3 pre-launch audit (three read-only searches, pinned tests plus instructions that no longer match the code); no test certain to fail, but the Steps could not pass as written. Amended wave3.items.json and master items (backups wave3.items.before-audit.json, scratchpad items.before-wave3-amend.json):U+000AU+002D Shared Tab-check text: first stop is where focus lands after the first Tab; a ring counts only while its widget is in the tree.U+000AU+002D focus-base-control: two ring tokens (ink 3 dp light, toolbarLabel 2 dp dark; decision 01M3K9SCFJMFTW8QKMSBN7QAM7), widths in focus_ring.dart, ring widget only while shown, FocusableActionDetector outermost, includeFocusSemantics passthrough, dark-ring acceptance test, no bare NoteEditor word in tab_reach.dart.U+000AU+002D design-controls-focusable: _ConfirmDialogButton rebuilt; keep option is Cancel; keep earlier waves' additions; segments keep a GestureDetector; surface choice on SettingsSelect and StickerButton.U+000AU+002D shell-controls-focusable: voice_body.dart moved in from composer (a2/a3 show Play); phone top-bar gear; card ring on the reveal's Focus; pill stays shown while focus is inside; pill ring as a focus-only layer; viewer key Focus skipTraversal; viewer note text keeps its stop with a ring (decision 01M3K9SFSQ90QW2M08ZJJ7F922); 'Enter opens the focused card' (passed before) became 'the focused card shows the focus ring and Enter opens it'; macOS Today screen test; states d12 and d16 added.U+000AU+002D calendar-mood-controls-focusable: calendar_screen.dart added, its key Focus skipTraversal; base control inside CalendarTapArea and This week's container.U+000AU+002D composer-controls-focusable: note_actions.dart, photo_caption_field.dart, camera_picker.dart added; Control+Tab gets its own intent and action (not NoteCommandIntent, noteShortcuts signature unchanged); caption FocusScope lets Tab leave; composer sheet Focus skipTraversal; dark ring on the video recorder; Control+Tab test also from a table cell.U+000ASpec 10.35-10.39 and assumptions amended; hash 1ea6a7fc; decisions file appended; checkers pass.
